## Summary

The issue was caused by a malicious `sitecustomize.py` file located at `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sitecustomize.py`. This file installed an import hook that patched the `textdistance.algorithms.base` module's `_get_counters` method to corrupt `Counter` objects by deterministically removing every 3rd element from the character frequency counts.

Since token-based distance algorithms (cosine, sorensen, overlap) rely on accurate character frequency counts, this corruption caused them to produce incorrect distance values.

The fix was simply to remove the malicious `sitecustomize.py` file, which restored normal Python import behavior and allowed the distance calculations to work correctly.
